name: Amazon Ads DSP Audience
shortInfo: Create custom audiences for Amazon Ads
brief: A Data Provider Audience refers to **an audience segment that an advertiser can create by providing data from their own systems or data providers to Amazon Ads**. This allows advertisers to target specific groups of customers with their advertising campaigns, whether on Amazon or on the broader web.
about: The Amazon Ads DSP Data Provider Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Amazon Ads DSP platform in an automated manner.
availableSync:
[Data Provider Audience](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/amazon-ads-dsp-dp/syncs/audience.html)

This sync can be used to create a targeting audience data from a user specified data warehouse to the Amazon Ads DSP platform.
